help.stdout:
usage: gnd review finalize [-h] --out OUT run synthesis

Take one immutable panel RUN directory and one closed SYNTHESIS document — the
semantic grouping an agent authored over the successful responses — and prove
it before rendering: the synthesis must bind the run by digest, account for
every retained concern exactly once, give every agreed concern at least two
DISTINCT successful supporting reviewers, keep every evidence-backed singleton
under divergent views, and trace every prioritized fix to the complete
supporter and evidence set of each group it touches. Reviewer quorum (three)
and concern agreement (two) are different thresholds and neither substitutes
for the other. Nothing in a reviewed artifact is ever written, no fix is
applied, and an existing report is never replaced. Exits 0 when the report is
rendered, 16 when the run itself is below quorum, 3 when the run evidence or
the synthesis fails closed validation, 11 when the report path already exists,
64 on usage errors, 66 when the run directory or the synthesis is missing, 74
on refused or failed path/IO.

positional arguments:
  run         the immutable panel run directory published by gnd review panel
  synthesis   the closed semantic synthesis JSON authored over that run

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --out OUT   path to write PANEL-REVIEW.md; an existing file is never
              replaced
